title.b: I Want To Go For You

meta.author:
小羊詩歌
詞、曲：林婉容 / 中文歌詞：倪兆康

lines.b: May Your Spirit come like a fire
Grant me power from places higher

lines.a: 讓聖火燒盡邪情和私慾
lines.b: And consume my every stray desire
For I want to go for You

lines.a: 成為我的異象 榮耀救主
lines.b: Show Your glory in a revelation

lines.a: 讓萬國的榮華盡都失色
lines.b: That outshines the splendor of the nations

lines.a: 賜我勇敢的心一無畏懼
lines.b: Give me boldness without hesitation
For I want to go for You
May I learn to think Your thoughts
And be led by Your own hands

lines.a: 看萬事為損失 受苦為小事
lines.b: May I suffer with joy and count all things loss
And by Your grace may I stand
May I learn to think Your thoughts
And be led by Your own hands

lines.a: 看萬事為損失 受苦為小事
lines.b: May I suffer with joy and count all things loss
And by Your grace may I stand
Lord, melt my heart with Your love
Refine my soul with Your fire

lines.a: 神聖的使命 佔有我
lines.b: With every mission, Lord send me
And Spirit, lead, be my guide

lines.a: 賜我勇敢的心一無畏懼
lines.b: Give me boldness without hesitation
For I want to go for You
